title: Degreewise currying map
statement: For every pair of cochain complexes K,L and a cochain complex M of sheaf modules over R, and every integer n, there exists a unique morphism from the degree-n term of homComplex K (homComplex L M) to the degree-n term of homComplex (mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M which satisfies the localized pure-tensor currying equation HomTensorCurryCondition; this morphism is an isomorphism.
